hook.rumour: Both the Surilie and Tamika vintage wains were ambushed outside Skingrad on the same night, and somebody left each rival's wax seal pinned to the smashed casks.
hook.notice: SKINGRAD VINTNERS' GUILD & CASTLE STEWARD: Experienced investigator wanted to examine the sabotaged wine-presses and missing reserve casks.

stages.objective: Inspect the smashed wine-casks and counterfeit wax stamps outside Skingrad's western gate
Question the cellar-carters drinking at The Blue Netch about the night wagons
Return the unstaved oak hoop to Castle Skingrad's steward

objectives.text: Inspect the smashed wine-casks and counterfeit wax stamps outside Skingrad's western gate
Question the cellar-carters drinking at The Blue Netch about the night wagons
Return the unstaved oak hoop to Castle Skingrad's steward

consequence_detail.summary: The smashed casks were filled with dyed vinegar while the real reserve vintage was carted west in unmarked cooperage.

stages.objective: Follow the cooper's iron-mark west from Skingrad along the Gold Road
Inspect the cellar receipts at the Roadside Gilded Carafe
Clear the cellar-raiders out of Fort Linchal and recover the stolen reserve casks

objectives.text: Follow the cooper's iron-mark west from Skingrad along the Gold Road
Inspect the cellar receipts at the Roadside Gilded Carafe
Clear the cellar-raiders out of Fort Linchal and recover the stolen reserve casks

consequence_detail.summary: Inside the false bottoms of the casks at Fort Linchal are blackmail dossiers on Elder Council nobles compiled for the Council of Ash.

stages.objective: Track the blackmail couriers west from Fort Linchal toward Fort Hastrel
Search the limestone name-vault beneath Fort Hastrel for the master cipher-book
Deliver the cipher-book to Count Hassildor's nocturnal chamberlain in Skingrad

objectives.text: Track the blackmail couriers west from Fort Linchal toward Fort Hastrel

consequence_detail.summary: The cipher-book reveals Cellar-Master Varo Caelius has been using Skingrad's wine shipments to smuggle Council of Ash blackmail across Tamriel.

stages.objective: Purge Varo Caelius's remaining syndicate cell at Fort Hastrel
Burn the Council of Ash blackmail rolls in Castle Skingrad's courtyard
Witness the Surilie and Tamika houses tap the reconciliation cask in Skingrad

consequence_detail.summary: Skingrad's rival wine houses unite under Count Hassildor's quiet protection, and the Council of Ash loses its western blackmail network.
